messages:
sasha: Quick sync — VerdantEdge private deployment review. Need to lock a time and final agenda so we can send the invite to the customer. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00 PT, Wed 14:00 PT, Thu 09:00 PT. React with :one:/:two:/:three: for preferences.

sasha: Agenda draft: 1) preflight checklist status (network, certs, quotas) 2) VPC peering & route table review 3) IAM/KMS and secrets handoff 4) Dedicated capacity sizing & autoscale policy 5) rollback/fallback and post-cutover monitoring 6) action items and owners. Add anything missing.

jia: Wed 14:00 PT works for me. Can you add a short block for "integration points" — their auth flow and where tokens live?

sasha: good call — adding "integration/auth" as item 3 and shifting IAM/KMS to 4.

omar: prefer Thu 09:00 PT (oncall Tue/Wed). If Thu is last resort I'm ok to join Wed for the core parts and handoff later.

leah: I'll own preflight checklist items. Current status: network diagram uploaded to the doc, customer still needs to confirm 2 static IPs and firewall rules. I can take notes on open ports.

alex: I'll cover capacity sizing and autoscale policy. Can we get their expected QPS and latency SLOs before the call? I emailed the AE yesterday but no reply yet.

sasha: AE said they'll try to get workload numbers by EOD today. If not, we'll use conservative defaults for the review and mark sizing as tentative.

jia: For the auth piece — customer uses their SSO to provision tokens via our onboarding lambda. Need to show the small code snippet and the secrets flow. I'll post snippet + diagram in the thread.

leah: posting the checklist excerpt here for quick review:
```
- network diagram (done)
- static IPs: pending (customer)
- firewall rules: pending (customer)
- certs: customer to provide SAN list by deploy meeting
- routes/peering: owned by Redwood infra team
- NTP & DNS validation: in runbook
```

sasha: nice. Can we also confirm who will join from the customer side? AE said: 1x infra engineer, 1x security, and the product lead.

alex: pinging deploy-bot for runbook link and the tenant-specific preflight checklist.

deploy-bot: Runbook generated: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/verdantedge/preflight-v1.4 — includes tenant checklist, sample iptables snippet, and required log collection commands.

omar: Thanks. One more ask: can someone prepare a short rollback play (3-step) to share during the meeting? I can lead that if no objections.

sasha: yes please — Omar to present rollback play.

leah: I'll attach the network diagram + firewall template to the calendar invite.

alex: If Wed ends up with majority votes, can we cover sizing in first 20m and leave the last 20 for Q/A and integration?

sasha: sounds good. Current emoji tally: :one: (Tue) 0, :two: (Wed) 2, :three: (Thu) 2. Looks like Wed/Thu tied — can folks who prefer Thu confirm if they can also do Wed as backup?

omar: I can only do Thu.

jia: I can do Wed but not Thu.

sasha: Ok — leaning Wed since critical folks (jia, alex) prefer Wed. I'll schedule Wed 14:00 PT and include a note that Omar will join the latter half or for follow-up if needed. Invite will include: agenda, runbook link, checklist snapshot, and request for customer to confirm IPs & cert SANs before meeting.

sasha: Action items before Wed: (1) AE to confirm workload numbers (sasha) (2) Customer to provide static IPs & cert SANs (AE/customer) (3) Jia to post auth snippet + diagram (jia) (4) Leah to attach network diagram & firewall template to invite (leah) (5) Omar to prepare 3-step rollback play (omar) (6) Alex to draft autoscale defaults doc for discussion (alex).

sasha: I'll send the invite in ~30m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
